sources.body: Synthetic publication abstract. In a fictional randomized study of 80 adults with Condition Y, 40 received Lantern Brief Skills and 40 received attention control. At six weeks, response occurred in 18 of 40 versus 12 of 40 participants; the synthetic risk-difference interval was -4 to 34 percentage points. Adverse events and subgroup outcomes were not reported in this abstract.
